Drag the slider to adjust how easily MotionAware area detects motion. If it's detecting too much motion and triggering lights when you don't want it to, change the sensitivity to low.

After adjusting, it will take about 15 seconds to calibrate.

taurus.edit.troubleshooting.subtitle: <olist><litem>If you have motion sensors or cameras in the same space, consider creating a Sensor group so they all work together</litem><litem>If you notice that your MotionAware area detects people in adjacent rooms or floors, please consider selecting lights farther away from walls or ceilings, adding a 4th light (if you have only 3) or lowering the motion sensitivity of the area</litem><litem>If you don't want your MotionAware area to detect your pets, consider lowering the sensitivity or choosing lights in areas where your pet is less likely to move around</litem><litem>If your MotionAware area detects you before you enter the room, consider selecting lights further into the room or lowering the motion sensitivity</litem><litem>If your MotionAware area detects you too late after you enter the room, consider selecting lights closer to the entrance or increasing the motion sensitivity</litem><litem>If your MotionAware area claims it is not working or unrecoverable, it means there is an issue with the lights participating in that area. Please make sure they are powered on and save your settings again.</litem></olist>

taurus.focusArea.title: Before you choose devices...
taurus.howItWorks.subtitle:
Hue devices continuously communicate with each other using Zigbee. 

Our MotionAware technology measures fluctuations in their Zigbee signals, which happen when something (like a person) passes through them.

Next, we’ll help you choose the best devices for a MotionAware area.
taurus.howItWorks.title: How it works
taurus.leaveRoom.subtitle: Let’s calibrate your MotionAware area. Make sure nobody, including pets, is in the area during the 20 seconds it'll take to calibrate.

taurus.lightsSelection.degradedUnreachab: One or more devices in your MotionAware area is <emph>unreachable</emph>, meaning that this area is not accurately sensing motion.
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.distance: <emph>Distance:</emph> Lights should be 0.9 to 7 metres apart for the best performance.
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.height: <emph>Height:</emph> Choose devices at varying heights (e.g. a ceiling light, floor lamp and table lamp).
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.location: <emph>Location:</emph> Choose an area with the most activity, such as paths and doorways.
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.noStraigh: <emph>No straight lines:</emph> MotionAware areas need to be 3D shapes, which straight lines can't create.
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.numberOfL: <emph>Number of lights:</emph> Use 3 or 4 devices to create an area.
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.poweredOn: <emph>Powered on:</emph> Make sure that your devices are connected to power (i.e. the wall switch is turned on) at all times. Still use some traditional wall switches with your Hue devices? Exclude them from your MotionAware area.
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.recommend: <emph>Indoors only:</emph> Zigbee signals need to bounce off their surroundings (e.g. walls) so that MotionAware can measure them. Because there are no walls, outdoor spaces don't allow effective measurement.
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.shape: <emph>Shape:</emph> the shape should cover as much of the area as possible, from the floor to the ceiling.
taurus.lightsSelection.getTips.title: More info

taurus.lightsSetup.subtitle:
Ideally, devices should be one to seven metres apart and at varying heights (e.g. a ceiling light, floor lamp and table lamp).

Devices should not be separated by a wall or in a straight line and must remain powered for the MotionAware area to detect you properly.
